System Visualization

Instructor: Amit K Biswal • Module: Spatial Visualization

To understand a system is to trace its currents. Each group explored the unseen webs of our world, seeking the quiet forces that shape places and infrastructures. Rather than just documenting what is there, we used the art of visual storytelling as an instrument of inquiry. We drew the invisible flows of reality into a rich, cohesive picture, revealing the delicate balance of the present and the spaces where new designs can take root.
